title: IVG Pro 12 Grape Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Grape Ice IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods combine the deep sweetness of ripe Grape with a refreshing Menthol chill for a fruity yet cooling vape. The smooth, candy-like grape flavour takes centre stage, lifted by an icy exhale that keeps the taste clean and bright from start to finish. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically supplies the pod as you vape, removing the need for refilling or coil changes. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth MTL vapour with consistent flavour, while the click-fit design allows for quick, spill-free setup. Designed exclusively for the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
